change_summary: oya-search-query-domain: add QueryRoutingMode (3-variant physical-shard-pool selector) via new query_routing_mode module + re-export. No new crates, no new workspace deps, std-only. M03-P05 merge-variant delta-1.

findings: QueryRoutingMode separates the physical-routing concern from QueryMode (which describes query semantics). The distinction removes an implicit coupling: today every consumer that checks QueryMode to decide shard fan-out re-implements the same switch. A dedicated type eliminates that duplication.
3 variants cover the exhaustive space (inverted-only / vector-only / both). No over-engineering.
to_wire / from_wire named per project convention (not from_str, avoiding clippy::should_implement_trait).
Copy + Clone on a 1-byte discriminant: zero heap allocation on dispatch path.
Ord derived so a coordinator can sort routing decisions by fan-out cost without a custom comparator.
Wire encoding is a stable u8: safe for on-wire protocol versioning without serde.
from_wire(99) returns Err(UnknownWireValue) — unknown bytes are rejected, not silently coerced.
wire_round_trip_all_variants exercises all 3 variants ensuring encode/decode symmetry.
needs_inverted / needs_vector tested for all 3 variants (9 assertions total).
Module doc-comment cites M03-P05-IP-001/IP-002 per codebase convention.
Each public item has a doc-comment explaining its semantic role.
data_class annotations omitted per std-only / no-serde constraint — not applicable here as no struct fields.
